profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Detail oriented software engineer specialized in native development for Apple platforms in Swift and Objective-C.

I strive to write well designed and maintainable software, and love learning and adopting new technologies. I’m motivated by creating meaningful and delightful user experiences that enrich user’s lives.

positions.title: Senior iOS Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated an internal cross-platform C++ computer vision and 3D graphics rendering engine with Snapchat’s native iOS code.
• Implemented new UI and logic to support new AR features; maintained and improved the video processing pipeline.
• Implemented post-capture AR processing.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Objective-C · C++ · Camera Pipeline · Augmented Reality (AR)

positions.title: Senior iOS Engineer
positions.description:
• State of the art computer vision technology that allows 3D capture on mobile devices with no special hardware. Acquired by Snap Inc. in 2016.
• Contributed to all app aspects, focusing on delightful UX.
• Developed and adopted groundbreaking new features: CardboardVR support; face scanning with OBJ export; Sketchfab integration.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Objective-C · User Experience (UX) · Camera Pipeline · Augmented Reality (AR)

positions.title: Senior iOS Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team of three iOS developers in developing an iOS “guess the word” game implemented
by completely customizing UIKit’s appearance. (youtube.com/watch?v=K8L8xlWc_Ag)
• Major contributor to a Tower Defense game written in Obj-C using cocos2d. (youtube.com/watch?v=OONstlv3OV8)
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Objective-C · Cocos2d · Game Development

positions.title: iOS Engineer
positions.description:
• Major contributor to a 2D bubble bursting game. (youtube.com/watch?v=Aibfncgoh-A)
• Had input on game design, involvement in all parts of the game from production to release.

Award: Best of 2012 iTunes Store Selection by Apple.
Award: Best Game for Mobile Devices at the 2012 Videogame Industry Awards by the Spanish
Academy of Interactive Sciences and Arts
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Objective-C · Cocos2d · Game Programming

company.name: Super Awesome Hyper Dimensional Mega Team

positions.title: Pattern Recognition and Natural Language Processing Academic Researcher
positions.description:
Research within the Statistical Pattern Recognition and Natural Language Processing fields.

Worked at the 'Pattern Recognition and Human Language Technologies' research group (https://prhlt.upv.es/).

List of my published papers in this period: http://goo.gl/y2Gln4

2010-10 - 2011-02. International stay as a fellow researcher at St. Andrews University (Scotland).

educations.fieldOfStudy: Artificial Intelligence and Digital Imaging, Natural Language Processing

projects.title: [Open Source Framework] ResearchKit
projects.description:
ResearchKit is an open source software framework that makes it easy to create apps for medical research or for other research projects.

I've been steadily contributing improvements and new features to ResearchKit since it was released in April 2015.

projects.title: [App] Seene
projects.description:
Seene lets you capture, share and discover 3D photos easily on your phone.

I was a key contributor to the 2.0 re-write and re-design of the app. We continue to improve and refine the Seene experience.
